mapper.insert:
insert into mark_order_item
order_id, phone, unit_price, item_amount, process_status, process_result, process_note, processed_by, processed_time, refunded, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark,
#{orderId}, #{phone}, #{unitPrice}, #{itemAmount}, #{processStatus}, #{processResult}, #{processNote}, #{processedBy}, #{processedTime}, #{refunded}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{remark},
mapper.select:
select moi.id, moi.order_id, mo.order_no, mo.platform_code, mo.platform_name, moi.phone, moi.process_status, moi.process_result, moi.process_note, moi.processed_by, moi.processed_time, moi.create_by, moi.create_time, moi.update_by, moi.update_time, moi.remark, su.user_name as user_name, mo.remark as order_remark from mark_order_item moi inner join mark_order mo on mo.id = moi.order_id left join sys_user su on su.user_id = mo.user_id
and mo.audit_status = '1'
and ( mo.assigned_agent_id = #{agentId} or (mo.assigned_agent_id is null and su.create_by = #{agentUsername}) or exists ( select 1 from sys_user agent_u inner join sys_user_role aur on aur.user_id = agent_u.user_id inner join sys_role ar on ar.role_id = aur.role_id and ar.role_key in ('agent', 'mark_agent') where agent_u.user_id = #{agentId} and agent_u.del_flag = '0' and agent_u.rel_mark_template is not null and agent_u.rel_mark_template > 0 and su.rel_mark_template = agent_u.rel_mark_template ) or exists ( select 1 from mark_platform_template mpt where mpt.id = su.rel_mark_template and mpt.owner_user_id = #{agentId} and mpt.status = '0' ) )
and moi.phone like concat('%', #{query.phone}, '%')
and moi.process_status = #{query.processStatus}
and moi.process_status = '0' and lower(mo.platform_code) not in ('tencent_mark', 'tengxun', 'tencent', 'tx', 'txwz', 'td_gaopin')
and ( moi.process_status = '3' or ( moi.process_status = '0' and lower(mo.platform_code) in ('tencent_mark', 'tengxun', 'tencent', 'tx', 'txwz', 'td_gaopin') ) )
and moi.process_status in ('1', '2')
and mo.platform_code = #{query.platformCode}
and find_in_set(mo.platform_code, #{query.platformCodes})
and moi.create_time >= #{query.params.beginTime}
and moi.create_time <= concat(#{query.params.endTime}, ' 23:59:59')
order by moi.create_time desc, moi.id desc
inner join mark_order mo on mo.id = moi.order_id where moi.process_status = '0' and mo.audit_status = '1' and mo.platform_code = 'td_gaopin' order by moi.update_time asc, moi.id asc limit #{limit}

inner join mark_order mo on mo.id = moi.order_id where moi.process_status = '0' and mo.audit_status = '1' and lower(mo.platform_code) = 'xiaomi' and (moi.process_result is null or trim(moi.process_result) = '') order by moi.update_time asc, moi.id asc limit #{limit}

inner join mark_order mo on mo.id = moi.order_id where moi.process_status = '3' and mo.audit_status = '1' and lower(mo.platform_code) = 'xiaomi' order by moi.update_time asc, moi.id asc limit #{limit}

select distinct moi.phone from mark_order_item moi inner join mark_order mo on mo.id = moi.order_id where mo.user_id = #{userId} and mo.platform_code = 'td_gaopin' and mo.audit_status = '1' and moi.process_status = '0' and moi.phone in
#{phone}
